limitations: A correction is published only when the same institute has a 2022 wave containing both first-round and runoff scenarios within the ±14-day horizon tolerance.
The correction combines institute error and genuine opinion change between the historical poll and election day; it is not interpreted as a permanent causal bias.
PNAD, demographic reconstruction and current-cycle residual standardization are not inputs.
Monte Carlo compares raw and corrected estimates using the same latest eligible wave per canonical institute and equal institute weight.
The predictive error is calibrated from one historical election (2022), so probabilities and intervals remain research-only rather than independently validated forecasts.
Prediction-market prices are displayed separately and never enter the polling correction or simulation.
